# Tidjani & Brothers

> Tidjani & Brothers is an IT services company based in Yaoundé, Cameroon.
> We help small and medium businesses (PME) across Cameroon adopt Odoo ERP,
> and build custom web sites, for a unified, locally-supported tech stack.

Language: French (primary site content). Currency: FCFA. Service area: Cameroon.

## Services

- Odoo ERP installation and support: invoicing, inventory, sales, accounting,
  CRM, point of sale, mobile money integration (MTN MoMo, Orange Money).
  https://tidjaniandbrothers.com/services/odoo
- Odoo training (initial, continuing, advanced/key-user), on-site or remote.
  https://tidjaniandbrothers.com/services/formation
- Web design: storefront, e-commerce, portfolio, and custom sites, connected
  to the same Odoo backend when relevant.
  https://tidjaniandbrothers.com/services/web-design

- Homepage: https://tidjaniandbrothers.com/

## Notes for agents

- Structured data (schema.org LocalBusiness, Service, BlogPosting,
  BreadcrumbList) is embedded as JSON-LD on the relevant pages.
- The `/admin` and `/api` paths are internal and excluded via robots.txt.
